Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: Client testimonial and review submitted for custom carpentry and woodwork projects.

clientName.description: Name of the client who submitted the feedback

projectType.description: Category or type of woodwork project (e.g. Modular Kitchen, Fitted Wardrobes)

quote.description: Client's review comment or quote describing their experience

location.description: Area or neighborhood of the project (e.g. Indiranagar, Whitefield)

clientRole.description: Role of the client (e.g. Homeowner, Architect)

verifiedProject.description: Whether the review is from a verified on-site project

date.description: Formatted month and year of the project (e.g. October 2026)

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp string of submission

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Public client feedback and reviews visible across all devices in real-time.
